settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: By default, the system language is used on first launch.
settings.alertSoonDaysHint: How many days ahead an installment is flagged as "due soon" on the Alerts page (1–90).
settings.logoHint: Shown in the header and sidebar.
settings.backupHint: Save a copy of your database. Deleting a client also deletes their purchases and payments, and that cannot be undone.
settings.backupTimeHint: The copy is made at this time while the application is open. If it was closed, it is made the next time you open it.
settings.backupNever: This database has never been backed up.
settings.backupAutoLast: Automatic copy on this computer: {date}. It does not replace a backup kept elsewhere.
settings.backupAutoNone: No automatic copy yet. One is made when the application starts.
